personal.title: My garden
personal.scene: My observing garden with flowers and starlight
personal.welcome: A little place under the stars
personal.intro: Grow your little garden as you observe and learn.
personal.pickSlot: Choose a spot, then a decoration.
personal.free: Starter decorations are free. Observing and learning achievements unlock more.
personal.name: Garden name
personal.saved: Changes are saved on this device.
personal.error: Could not save your changes. Please try again.

social.title: Community photos
social.coming: A place to share your sky
social.comingBody: Photo sharing and comments are coming soon. Your garden and observation log are available now.
social.emptyBody: Share a moment you captured under the sky.
social.deleteConfirm: Delete this content? A deleted photo must be uploaded again to restore it.
social.blockConfirm: Block this person? While signed in, you will not see each other’s photos or comments.
social.appealReason: What would you like us to reconsider?
social.reviewHint: Comments appear after a moderator reviews them.
social.pendingNotice: Submitted. It will be shared after review.
social.rateLimit: Please wait before trying again. You may have reached today’s limit.
social.accountUnavailable: This account cannot post right now. Check the review history in your account.
social.error: Could not complete the request. Your input is still here; please try again.
social.uploadHint: Choose a photo you took. We keep your original unchanged and create a sharing copy without location metadata.
social.caption: About this photo
social.publishConsent: I have permission to share this image and agree to publish it with its description. I have checked it for faces, home addresses and other personal information.
social.imageError: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image up to 20 MB.
social.loginHint: Sign in to share photos, comment or keep a private backup.
social.codeSent: Check your email and enter the verification code here.
social.rules: Be kind. Share only images you own or have permission to share. Hate, harassment, spam and disclosure of personal information are not allowed. Content can be reported, hidden or removed by moderators.
social.privacy: Your email stays private. Your public name, shared photos, descriptions and comments can be seen by others. Observation logs and backups are kept separately and never published automatically.
social.agreeRules: I have read and agree to the community terms and privacy information.
social.accountIntro: Your log stays on this device. Shared photos belong to your account.
social.backupHint: Save your log, photos, learning and garden. Keep up to five backups, each up to 20 MB. Backups do not sync automatically.
social.backupConsent: Privately back up this device’s observations, locations, photos, learning and garden to this account? On a shared device, check that this data belongs to you.
social.restoreConfirm: This backup contains {{count}} observations. Merge it using the newer version of matching items? Consider exporting your current data first.
social.restored: Imported. Reopen the app to apply all display settings.
social.deleteBackupConfirm: Delete this cloud backup? Your device data will remain.
social.signedOut: Signed out. Your local log and garden remain.
social.deleteAccountHint: Delete your account, shared photos, comments and cloud backups. Your local log and garden will remain.
social.deleteAccountConfirm: Permanently delete your online account, shared photos, comments and cloud backups? This cannot be undone.
social.accountDeleted: Your online account has been deleted.
social.moderatorsOnly: Sign in with a moderator account.
social.reviewRules: Open photos before reviewing them. Check privacy, rights and harassment, and explain decisions to the author. Report counts alone must not determine sanctions.
social.reviewReason: Review reason to share with the author
social.reauth: To delete your account, sign out and sign in again first.
social.backupTooLarge: This backup exceeds 20 MB. Export a file backup on this device instead.
social.emailUnavailable: Public sign-up emails are not available yet. Observing, learning and your garden work without signing in.
social.loginLinkError: Could not verify the link. Open it in the browser where you requested it, or request a new one.
social.pilot: Accounts are currently in an operator pilot. Public sign-ups will open when email delivery is ready.
social.linkSent: Open the email’s sign-in link in this browser.
social.editHint: Edited posts are reviewed again before publication.
